name: PFM-DTE-015 X clear button on the date range field clears the selected range

statusDetails.message:
XFAIL Known gap PFM-DTE-015: no clear/X button found for the date range field in the current build — direct JS click on all buttons in the input's ancestor tree does not change the field value. Either the clear button is absent or requires a React internal state event that Selenium cannot dispatch. Needs DevTools inspection to identify the clear mechanism.

AssertionError: Date range field not cleared after clicking X. Value: '06/01/2026 - 06/30/2026'
assert ('06/01/2026 - 06/30/2026' == ''
  
  + 06/01/2026 - 06/30/2026 or '06/01/2026 - 06/30/2026' != '06/01/2026 - 06/30/2026')
